definition: short-window normalized true range / long-window normalized true range; closed-bar breakout signal, next-bar-open parameter search with an independent next-persisted-Tick fill check

selection.rule: maximize the weaker train/validation geometric daily return, then penalize worst drawdown; require at least three completed trades in both periods

target.note: 5% per active day is a research aspiration, not an acceptance override

decision.reason: positive frozen holdout, but sample size and profit concentration are insufficient

parameter_neighborhood.method: one parameter varied at a time around the selected candidate

walk_forward.selection_rule: development geometric daily return with drawdown penalty
weaker train/validation daily return with drawdown penalty

atr_baseline_comparison.baseline: ATR(32) x 3 long-only Tick replay, 1.25x exposure
atr_baseline_comparison.caveat: Daily-path comparison only: ATR uses Tick replay while volatility spread uses official 15m bars and next-open fills. Intraday drawdowns are not comparable.

next_persisted_tick_fill_check.method: Signals and risk checks remain on closed official 15m bars; each pending action fills on the first persisted 250ms aggregate Tick inside the next bar.
next_persisted_tick_fill_check.scope_limit: This validates fill timing and price only. Drawdown remains marked on 15m closes, not on every intrabar Tick.
